data.long_meaning: Amisha is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘amrish’, meaning 'immortal' or 'imperishable'. In Hindu mythology, Amisha is a divine name, believed to bring blessings of eternal happiness and prosperity. The name Amisha carries the meaning “Immortal, Imperishable” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Amisha usually hope their child will grow to embody immortal, imperishable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
